rachel: quick sync - we need a short, actionable checklist for the HW vendor onramp. focus: H200 kernel ABI, MI300 rack labels, and marketplace pilot copy.

omar: agree. short bullets please.

vendor_contact: H200 firmware will land next Tue; we'll supply firmware sha and rack manifest by EOD Wed. MI300 pilot racks available as promised.

jin: proposed checklist:
- vendor: provide firmware SHA + manifest
- eng: rebuild kernel modules and run smoke perf (seq 128/512)
- infra: reserve lab block and tag racks in inventory
- product: draft "pilot-compatible" marketplace copy

ops-bot: Lab reservation: rack 9C booked May 18-22. Auto reminder 48h prior.

rachel: owners? @vendor_contact -> artifacts, @jin -> CI job, @omar -> marketplace copy. I'll own runbook doc and legal loop.

vendor_contact: ack. sending artifacts Wed.

omar: I'll post pilot copy by Thu and include note about embargo 72h.

jin: CI command for kernel rebuild:
`ci-run --target=h200,mi300 --job=abi-check --out out/abi.tar.gz`

rachel: thanks. I'll update the partnership drive and ping once manifests land.
